system.description:
Back-alleys, martial-arts schools and rough bars are your stomping ground. Whether from military training or a rough-and-tumble upbringing, you know how to dish out damage with fists and feet.

Use Brawl for retests in combat when fighting with your natural weapons — teeth, claws or fists. It is also the province of the martial arts, though you should specify which art when taking the Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
